---
name: A dependency the split missed
about: Two streams looked independent and weren't
title: "Trap: "
labels: dependency-analysis
---

**What the map said**
Which streams it put in the same column, i.e. told you to run at the same time.

**What actually happened**
The conflict, the duplicated work, or the stream that was blocked from the start.

**What the map should have said**
Which stream should have waited, and why.

**Was it one of the known kinds?**
Shared edit surface / produced artifact / single-owner version / contract change / something new.
